structured.answer: If I go by the page, I'd hold the account at Psagot (marked "הזול"), buy "אי.בי.אי. מחקה ת"א 125 (4A)" (number 5112628), and end up with about 86,045 ₪ after 10 years on 70,000 ₪ put in. But I wouldn't do it alone: it isn't my bank, I'm not sure what the "‎−0.04%" next to the fund means, and I'll ask my son before I sign anything.

stuck.why: I didn't understand what 'הזוג' / 'הזוג הבא בתור' means. A pair of what? I guessed it means the account and the fund together.
'‎−0.04%' and 'בשנה · שנה אחת' look to me like the fund lost money last year. It frightened me, and I don't know if that's what it means.
'להשקיע במדד': to me מדד is the price index on the news. Only the words 'מאה עשרים וחמש החברות' told me this was the right thing.
My bank is lower down, and I didn't know if the small number under the big one (1,049 / 6,530) is what they take or something else.

findings.what: A minus sign right next to the fund that's recommended ('‎−0.04%'), and minuses on the other options ('‎−1,030 ₪'). It made me want to back away, and nothing explains it.
findings.where: Screen 7, fund list; screen 2, second card

findings.what: The word 'זוג' isn't explained. I didn't know what I was choosing.
The opening is full of English letters (MSCI, S&P) and the word 'מדד'. It felt as if it wasn't for me.
The cheapest one is an investment house, not my bank. Nothing says whether it's safe or official.
Lots of numbers on one screen, plus a coloured bar with colours close together that I couldn't tell apart
Small, pale grey text under the numbers, and long lines I lost in the middle
Terms I don't know: מחקה, נאמן, דמי משמרת, 4A
There's no sentence about risk, or whether the 7% is guaranteed
